title: Camps C12 — “Reopen sign-up” becomes “Open sign-up”
subtitle: Rule v1.016: one verb pair with each section’s own noun and no icons — Close sign-up / Open sign-up in Camps (Color Belt, Star and Black Belt say Close / Open registration; Forms Close / Open form). The camp’s ⋯ menu (on the Camps list and in the camp page header). Camps’ items already have no icon. Amber = what changes.
